ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 97% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 3% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigment distribution across both lobes; no large-scale white mottling or contiguous geometric blobs present. Small, high-contrast pixels are localized only to individual scars and external attachments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees at the central vertex; depth is approximately 18% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits approximately 9-11 distinct peaks with moderate amplitude. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits smaller, more jagged peaks with lower amplitude and higher frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep; edges follow a convex trajectory from the notch transitioning into a subtle concavity toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of textured, roughly circular, high-intensity pixel masses located on the far-left lateral tip (barnacle colonization). Single isolated circular high-intensity point located on the lower-mid region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive rake marks on the right lobe consisting of three primary parallel diagonal high-intensity lines and several secondary intersecting horizontal scratches. Left lobe shows a single prominent diagonal linear disruption near the upper-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle clusters on the distal end of the left lobe; multiple intersecting linear rake marks on the surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated circular high-intensity ring-shaped marking (O-shape) located in the mid-section of the left lobe.
